rule: Drawn formats: joke structures drawn only with the brand's own characters, backgrounds and props (use for ads and when no team template fits). Team-supplied real templates live in library/memes/templates and are for organic posts only.

formats.name: Reject / Prefer
formats.how: Top row: a character refusing something (blank or serious mood, hand up). Bottom row: the same character delighted (happy). Text on the right of each row.
formats.use_for: The old habit vs the better way

formats.name: Four levels
formats.how: Four rows, the same idea getting smarter or more absurd. The character's mood climbs (calm → smile → happy → awe) and the background gets brighter each row.
formats.use_for: Escalating sophistication, last level absurd or the brand's idea

formats.name: Nobody: / Me:
formats.how: Caption band: 'Nobody:' then 'Me:' and the absurd thing. The panel shows the character doing it.
formats.use_for: A habit the audience recognises in themselves

formats.name: POV
formats.how: Caption: 'POV: you …'. The panel shows the scene from the viewer's side.
formats.use_for: Put the viewer inside a relatable moment

formats.name: Expectation vs reality
formats.how: Two panels side by side labelled EXPECTATION and REALITY. Same character, opposite outcome.
formats.use_for: The fantasy vs what actually happens

formats.name: Them / Me
formats.how: Two panels labelled with two types of people (e.g. 'Coaches with ads' / 'Coaches with a community').

formats.name: Day 1 vs Day 100
formats.how: Same character and place, two moments: beginning vs later.

formats.name: What I asked for / What I got
formats.how: Left: the plan. Right: the funny result.

formats.name: Starter pack
formats.how: A title band 'The ___ starter pack' and a 2×3 grid of props or mini scenes, each with a short label.
formats.use_for: Affectionate stereotype of an archetype from audience.json

formats.name: Tier list
formats.how: Rows S, A, B, C, D with coloured letter boxes; items are short labels or props.

formats.name: The impossible choice
formats.how: The character sweating between two labelled doors or buttons (the 'doors' background).

formats.name: Me explaining
formats.how: Caption 'Me explaining ___ to ___'. Panel: a character at the board, the other bored or asleep.
formats.use_for: Explaining something obvious to someone who doesn't get it

formats.name: Hot take sign
formats.how: A character holding a sign with a bold opinion.

formats.name: The chart
formats.how: A cartoon chart with an absurd axis (e.g. 'Posts per day' vs 'Sales').

formats.name: Reaction caption
formats.how: One reaction image of a character (any mood) under a caption describing the moment.
formats.use_for: Universal reaction to a niche moment
